items.source: PartialUpdate allows to issue individual property updates without the need of rewriting the whole entity. It allows to define set, delete actions on existing objects while taking care of updating potential expiration times of the entity itself as well as index structures.
items.translation: PartialUpdate 允许在不重写整个实体的情况下发布单个属性更新。它允许在现有对象上定义设置和删除操作，同时负责更新实体本身的过期时间以及索引结构。
